title.rendered: Netflix’s “Talbot Pines” is Casting Extras & Stand-Ins in Georgia

content.rendered:
NOW CASTING FEATURED BACKGROUND ROLES

ROLE – SISTER

Hylton Casting is now casting the featured background role of SISTER for the Netflix television series Talbot Pines.
We are seeking a Caucasian female, ages 9–14, to portray the younger sister of one of the series’ principal cast members. This featured, non-speaking role will work in exterior summer camp scenes and alongside the principal cast.

We’re looking for kids with expressive personalities who can take direction well and deliver natural, authentic reactions on camera. Previous acting, theater, commercial, improv, or on-set experience is encouraged but not required.
Filming Date: Monday, July 20, 2026
Location: Rutledge, GA
Rate: $140/10 hrs
To view the full role details and submit for consideration, please visit:
https://hyltoncasting.com/tpsister/

FILMING LOCATION:
Porterdale, GA & Monticello, GA
FILMING DATES:
Multiple Dates
July 8, 9, 13, 14 & 15, 2026

$300/12 Hours
